title: Roman Numeral to Integer
description: Convert a valid Roman numeral to its integer value. The symbols are `I`, `V`, `X`, `L`, `C`, `D`, and `M`; subtract a symbol when it is smaller than the symbol immediately following it, and otherwise add it. Input: a canonical Roman numeral from 1 through 3999. Output: its integer value.
constraints: s is a canonical Roman numeral representing an integer from 1 through 3999
hints: Track only the character counts or prefixes needed to decide the next step.
Check repeated symbols, empty or minimal cases, and impossible arrangements.
